subject: english
stem: The speakers have just checked the class notice. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: a question about when the plant trays arrived at the science room
a request to move the plant trays to the science room
a request to move the plant trays to the train station
an offer to store the plant trays in the science room

optionRationales.reason: a question about when the plant trays arrived at the science room：此項把「request to move the plant trays to」改成「question about when the plant trays arrived at」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the plant trays to the science room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the plant trays to the science room」。
a request to move the plant trays to the science room：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the plant trays to the science room」。

a request to move the plant trays to the train station：此項把「science room」改成「train station」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the plant trays to the science room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the plant trays to the science room」。

an offer to store the plant trays in the science room：此項把「a request to move the plant trays to」改成「an offer to store the plant trays in」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the plant trays to the science room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the plant trays to the science room」。
